annotations.title: Klausel gegen die rote Liste lesen

description: Germany only. Read one clause of a German employment contract against 17 clause types that are void or prohibited under German law (rote Liste), e.g. all overtime paid with the salary, non-compete without compensation, cut-off periods without exceptions. Returns matches with reason, norm and the safe alternative clause. No match is not a legal review of validity. The text is only read, never stored.
